name: run-deployer
description: Install PHP Deployer and run a dep command, reporting warnings/errors via reviewdog.

version.description: The version of Deployer to install. If not specified, the latest version will be used.

DEP.description: The deployer command to run. If not specified, the default is "deploy".

OPTIONS.description: Options to pass to the deployer command.

SELECTOR.description: The selector to use for the deployer command. If not specified, the default is "all".

ENVIRONMENT.description: The environment to use for the deployer command. If not specified, the default is determined by git branch.

BRANCH_SCOPE.description: Branch name identifying an isolated per-branch preview deployment. Forwarded as --branch-scope to Deployer. Leave empty for a normal (non-preview) deployment.

github-token.description: GitHub token for reviewdog reporting of Deployer warnings/errors as check annotations.

reviewdog-version.description: The version of reviewdog to install.

deploy-url.description: The deployed URL (https://<alias>), captured from the ##KLICK_DEPLOY_URL## log marker. Empty for non-deploy commands (unlock/teardown). If the selector matched more than one host in a single run, only the last host printed is returned - keep selectors scoped to one host per job (as this package's own workflows do via matrix + alias=<host>) to get an unambiguous value.
